name: change-oracle-planted-z
cmd: set -e; for g in z spacetime mix_0.6 mix_0; do {python} research/exp/change_oracle.py --cache {cache}/planted_v2_tempho1995 --out {out}/$g --population withheld --ranks 24 --species-regex "^${g}_" > /dev/null; done
summarize: for g in z spacetime mix_0.6 mix_0; do echo "== $g"; {python} research/exp/change_oracle.py --summarize {out}/$g; done
note: verification (a) for E011: the oracle and its placebos on planted species with known generators
